rules: When the age-appropriate story, activity sequence, exact source text, and visual direction are approved for asset production.
When the black-and-white line art and colored reference assets are generated, inspected, and ready for independent review.
When story correspondence, character consistency, child safety, or printable visual quality requires illustration fixes.
When the coloring assets and colored references pass review and are ready for print-package assembly.
When the ordered black-and-white and colored-reference packages pass final mechanical QA and the coordinator needs the final delivery status.
